  product: windows
  category: process_creation
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '%AppData%'
      - '%LocalAppData%'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
description: Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from user-writable directories, commonly abused by malware for defense evasion.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DynamicStrings {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon through dynamic string patterns in memory or file"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260411"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC Attribution 4.0 International"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:WHITE"

        $beacon_jitter = "jitter" fullword ascii

        $crypt_mode = "Crypt::" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
